newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes firmer on dollar supply.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes firmer on dollar supply.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed firmer at 43.7480/7500 to the dollar in interbank trading on Monday, against a previous close of 43.7500/7570, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted stronger and in a wide range at 43.7450/7550 per dollar in early trade and retained the edge on dollar selling by both foreign and state-owned banks.
Deals were mostly done at 43.7490 per dollar level throughout the session amid a steady supply of the greenback.
The interbank call money rates closed easier at five to 5.5 percent against a previous 5.5 to six percent.
